run_parallel_inference: run a binary cfg.NUM_GPUS times in parallel as subprocesses each using one GPU for multi-GPU inference
split_data_across_gpus: split a data range across multiple GPUs and run a binary on each subrange in parallel
capture_subprocess_output: capture and log the stdout of each parallel subprocess in real time or buffered mode
review_process_in_parallel: review the process_in_parallel function that spawns GPU-bound subprocesses and collates their pickled results
refactor_log_subprocess_output: refactor the log_subprocess_output function to stream or buffer stdout from parallel inference subprocesses
